committee: Joint Select Committee on School Facilities
location: Thyra Thomson State Office Building, Turn Table Conference Room, 3rd Floor Room 3017 444 W Collins Drive
title: The purpose of this meeting is to consider draft legislation regarding major maintenance calculations, minor capital construction funding, the School Facilities Commission's supplemental budget, and safety and security funding. The Committee will also receive information on virtual education student enrollment, potential minimum funding for major maintenance, and additional information on school facility insurance.
